description: Connect your AI agent to 3,000+ services without writing OAuth plumbing — users authorize once, agents act on their behalf.

interface.shortDescription: Connect your AI agent to 3,000+ services without writing OAuth plumbing — users authorize once, agents act on their behalf.
interface.longDescription:
LLMs can't natively talk to Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, or any OAuth service. Every connector means custom OAuth flows, token storage, refresh logic, and scope enforcement — weeks of plumbing before your agent does anything useful.

AgentKit handles the entire delegation layer: users authorize once, tokens never touch your code, agents call tools under user permissions with full audit trails. 3,000+ connectors. Works with any LLM or framework. Scoped to the user, not a service account.
